spatializationModel.description: Per-emitter override of the listener's spatialization model.

distanceCurve.description: Gain values in [0, 1], sampled uniformly from refDistance (index 0) to maxDistance (last index), linearly interpolated. Used when the base emitter's distanceModel is 'custom'.

coneOuterCutoff.description: Low-pass cutoff in Hz applied at and outside the cone's outer angle; no filtering at or inside the inner angle; interpolated linearly in log-frequency between the angles. Only applies when shapeType is 'cone'.

dopplerEnabled.description: Per-emitter Doppler opt-out within the environment's Doppler settings.
